reviews.review: Extremely fast paced and fun, it stands out from the other great roguelike FPS Gunfire by being smooth as butter and having insanely fun movement.
this game is mad fun but no matter who hosts it it always lags in multiplayer

TL;DR - Fun game. Easy to pick up and play anytime. Music slaps. Strong recommendation. Try it out.

You get the fun of using crazy weapons from a class-based looter-shooter without any of the min-maxing or the time commitment of spending hours to get a build going (my average run times are around 30-50 minutes). Weapon stats don't matter anywhere near as much here as weapon perks do, but you do have to be somewhat mindful of weapon levels if you don't switch gear that much during a run.

Most of the enemy attacks are projectiles or melee, and there are threat markers that appear on-screen when an enemy is targeting you and winding up an attack so you won't get blindsided that often if you're paying attention. There's no penalty for taking your time outside of boss fights (a couple of bosses have some kind time-sensitive mechanic where the arena itself slowly changes), but you can earn currency bonuses for clearing out a level quickly.

Expect a few framedrops in larger levels if you turn up the graphic settings, because the game will straight-up throw a swarm of dudes at you on a regular basis. It can get pretty chaotic sometimes.

Gamepad is a viable option, but you're gonna want to tweak the sensitivity to something you feel more comfortable with if you intend to use one. Might take some trial and error to get it just right. Most of the default camera settings felt way too high for me.

You can yeet yourself around in every fight if you learn how to slide-hop good. Usually gets me killed when I use it nonstop, but I don't really care because I'm having too much fun going fast all the time.
The most fun I've had in any FPS. Extremely fun and satisfying movement. Gun play is amazing with a wide selection of unique guns to choose from. 100% worth buying
